title: Last Bell, 2003
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Two weeks after the rack: the far sidewalk empty for three panels while the bell goes and the kids come out, and Wood arriving late in the fourth from the laundromat's direction with the dog. No mark in the margin; the strip is four months into none.

panels.composition: The school from across the road at 3:05, the bell shape, and the far sidewalk EMPTY.

image.prompt: a small-town high school seen from across a road with a jagged sound shape at its door and the near sidewalk empty, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: Students pouring out toward the beach road; the sidewalk still empty.

image.prompt: students pouring out of a school toward a beach road with the sidewalk across the road empty, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: The last of them gone; the sidewalk empty; a gull on the curb.

image.prompt: an empty sidewalk across from a school with a gull on the curb, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: WOOD arriving from the left with BARNABY, late, looking at the shut doors.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog arriving on a sidewalk and looking at a school's shut doors, brush-pen black and white

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: No mark. Four months of none.
